coreweave-dalton-ii-old-tilton-road-whit.name: CoreWeave Dalton II / Core Scientific Old Tilton Road Data Center
coreweave-dalton-ii-old-tilton-road-whit.developer: Core Scientific (site owner); CoreWeave Dalton II, LLC (sublessee/operator)

A June 2026 Whitfield Superior Court validated a $1.2B Integra SPV equipment-bond package tied to this ~167-173 acre site, naming CoreWeave Dalton II LLC as sublessee/operator. Same June 2026 hearing validated much larger CoreWeave Dalton / CoreWeave Dalton II bond series ($900M + $6.4B + $6.7B) that likely cover Core Scientific's OTHER Whitfield campus sites (Industrial South Road, Enterprise Drive) — those are separate parcels/rezonings and were not pursued as additional candidates this pass to avoid parcel-level double-counting; flagged for a future lane pass with GIS/parcel-level dedup once individual site addresses for those bond packages are confirmed.

qts-eisenhower-augusta-ga.name: QTS Project Eisenhower
qts-eisenhower-augusta-ga.water_notes: Closed-loop cooling that 'does not consume water for cooling once operational' (QTS); QTS discontinued evaporative cooling in 2018. An anticipated ~18,000 gal/day per building is for sanitation/domestic use (early-planning estimate, not a permitted figure). Augusta Utilities is in talks to supply treated wastewater as cooling feedstock; water source is the Savannah River basin via Augusta Utilities.
qts-eisenhower-augusta-ga.source: New data center will be twice as big as Augusta Mall
qts-eisenhower-augusta-ga.notes: Project Eisenhower in Augusta, Richmond County — 6 buildings across ~170 acres, $2B+ project. Rezoned 2024-25 with preliminary grading underway. Estimated 300-500 MW (not officially disclosed — omitted from capacity). Coordinates are the Augusta area centroid. The ~$2B figure is a developer projection from a 2024 zoning hearing (building permits not yet issued) -> investmentUsd omitted. QTS projects ~1,000 construction and ~160-220 permanent jobs (projections) -> jobs honest-zero. Georgia's high-technology data-center sales-tax exemption and an Augusta EDA bond/PILOT are available programs, but no confirmed award for this campus was found -> subsidy honest-zero.

google-council-bluffs-ia.name: Google Council Bluffs Data Center
google-council-bluffs-ia.powered_by: MidAmerican Energy Wind VIII program (up to 407 MW wind, REC-tracked)
google-council-bluffs-ia.source: Google Iowa — official location page: Council Bluffs operational since 2007, multi-building campus
google-council-bluffs-ia.notes: Google's flagship Iowa data center in Council Bluffs, Pottawattamie County — operational since 2007, heavily expanded across multiple buildings (the Southlands campus on Bunge Ave among them). Distinct from Google's tracked Cedar Rapids campus and from the separate proposed Google/Tenaska Nebraska project. Per Google's own location page, Google has invested $20B+ across Iowa since 2007 (Council Bluffs + Cedar Rapids combined — not a site-specific figure). No site-specific IT-load MW is disclosed. Coordinates are an approximate geocode of a disclosed campus address; a county-parcel pass could upgrade precision to exact.

aligned-ord-01-il.name: Aligned ORD-01
aligned-ord-01-il.notes: Confirmed via Aligned Chicago page and DatacenterDynamics ('Aligned completes first Chicago data center'); 505 Northwest Ave, Northlake, IL; 48MW, operational. AI/HPC (likely): Northlake ORD-01 hyperscale, adaptive AI/HPC cooling platform.

Each campus approximately 2-3 million sq ft. Sites on separate transmission lines for reliability. Coordinates use Shreveport as centroid; exact parcel locations not publicly mapped.

markley-boston-summer-street-ma.notes: Markley's original flagship facility (1 Summer St, atop former Macy's), 920,000 sq ft, largest commercial internet exchange point (BOSIX) in New England. Distinct facility from the separately-tracked Markley Lowell (One Lowell Data Center) site.

expedient-bwi1-owings-mills-md.notes: Confirmed via official Expedient directory: 11155 Red Run Blvd, Suite 200, Owings Mills, MD 21117. 800kW critical IT load, 22,000 sq ft. Distinct from the Tidepoint facility in Baltimore city.

google-project-mica-kc-northland-mo.name: Google Project Mica

google-project-mica-kc-northland-mo.notes: Five hyperscale data center buildings on 493 acres, northeast of I-435 and US-169 in KC Northland (near Smithville, Clay County). Google committed $1.5M to Smithville School District and $250K to Northland Career Center. Coordinates are approximate for the site northeast of the I-435/US-169 interchange.

metrobloks-liberty-mo.notes: $1.4B, 150 MW AI-ready campus in Liberty, Clay County. Coordinates are the Liberty area centroid.

patmos-kansas-city-mo.name: Patmos KC Star Building Campus
patmos-kansas-city-mo.source: List of upcoming data center projects in Missouri
patmos-kansas-city-mo.notes: ~$1B redevelopment of the former Kansas City Star building into a ~35 MW data center, Jackson County. Distinct (downtown KC, Jackson County) from the Lambda/Google/Meta Kansas City sites. Single-tracker source → confidence reported. Coordinates are the Kansas City centroid.

compass-lauderdale-meridian-ms.name: Compass Datacenters Lauderdale County Hyperscale Campus

compass-lauderdale-meridian-ms.notes: Eight-data-center campus over an eight-year buildout at the I-20/59 Industrial Park, Meridian. Groundbreaking Jan 28 2025 (under construction). INVESTMENT OMITTED: the widely cited $10B is a projected full-occupancy total INCLUDING future tenants' IT equipment ('an investment of $10 billion, including future tenants' information technology equipment'), not a firm Compass outlay. energy-storage-solutions-kingsboro-edgec.name: Kingsboro AI Data Center Campus

County cleared the way in Nov 2025 by amending its development ordinance; buildout planned across ~24 phases over 3-5 years. Twin campus announced for Fayetteville.

natelli-vance-county-henderson-nc.name: Natelli Vance County Campus (proposed)

applied-digital-polaris-forge-1-ellendal.name: Applied Digital Polaris Forge 1
applied-digital-polaris-forge-1-ellendal.water_notes: Proprietary waterless direct-to-chip liquid cooling; WUE near zero by design

applied-digital-polaris-forge-1-ellendal.notes: Campus is 400 MW fully contracted to CoreWeave under ~15-year lease agreements valued at ~$11B total revenue. Coordinates are Ellendale city centroid; exact site is northeast of the city. Local jobs are reported only as projections — 'as many as 85 new jobs' (Dec 2024) and up to ~110 total local workforce at full expansion — not confirmed headcounts. No confirmed total campus capital-expenditure figure is public (the ~$11B CoreWeave figure is 15-year lease revenue, not capex); North Dakota's data-center sales-tax exemption applies but individual award amounts are statutorily confidential. investmentUsd reflects Applied Digital's own infrastructure spend (~$1.3B committed + ~$4B anticipated); the company's '$20B total campus' figure additionally counts ~$15B of customer/tenant capital.

lumen-albany-4-ny.name: Lumen Albany 4
lumen-albany-4-ny.notes: 10 Airline Drive, Albany, NY — corroborated via datacentermap/datacenters.com listing distinct from Albany 1/3.

aws-industrial-parkway-jerome-township-o.name: AWS Industrial Parkway Campus (Jerome Township)
aws-industrial-parkway-jerome-township-o.source: Union County Auditor building record (parcel 1500220390010 / 8565 Industrial Pkwy — Amazon Data Services Inc, year built 2024, ~215,000 sq ft, $46.9M appraised building value, 86.2 ac)
aws-industrial-parkway-jerome-township-o.notes: Operational AWS data center on an ~86-acre Amazon Data Services Inc parcel at 8565 Industrial Pkwy, Jerome Township / Plain City, Union County — part of Amazon's AWS US-East-2 (Ohio) cluster in the Jerome Township / 'New California' corridor first announced Nov 2019 ($200M, ~125 acres at the NW corner of Warner Rd / Industrial Pkwy). Union County Auditor building record: year built 2024, ~215,000 sq ft assessed, $46.9M appraised building value. Sits ~2 km north of the Amazon Warner Rd campus (tracked separately) and is distinct from the still-vacant AWS 'Project Cosmos' site ~9 mi north in Marysville (Paris Township). No site-specific IT-load MW is disclosed. Coordinates are the Union County Auditor parcel centroid.

aws-beech-road-new-albany-oh.name: AWS New Albany (Beech/Miller Road Campus)
aws-beech-road-new-albany-oh.source: Licking County parcel/GIS record (AMAZON DATA SERVICES INC — Beech Rd NW / Miller Rd NW cluster; anchor parcel 095-111408, 199.81 ac)
aws-beech-road-new-albany-oh.notes: AWS's Licking-side New Albany expansion: a $3.5B, five-building, ~1.25M sq ft campus (announced Sept 2023, targeted through 2030) on the Amazon Data Services Beech Rd NW / Miller Rd NW parcel cluster (~458 ac). Two buildings were completed and staffed as of Aug 2025; the remainder are under construction. Adjacent to (but distinct from) AWS's pre-existing 2570 Beech Rd "Ridge Two" campus (operational since ~2017, a separate parcel not in this record). No site-specific IT-load MW is disclosed (a widely-repeated 500 MW figure is an AWS us-east-2 regional aggregate, not this campus). Amazon's 2023 Ohio Job Creation Tax Credit is a multi-site umbrella (17 facilities across Franklin/Licking/Union counties), not specific to this parcel. Distinct from tracked aws-cosgray-hilliard-oh and aws-scioto-darby-hilliard-oh (Hilliard, Franklin County, west of Columbus).

aligned-conesville-oh.name: Aligned Data Centers – Conesville Industrial Park
aligned-conesville-oh.water_notes: No cooling type or water consumption data disclosed. Former coal plant had access to Muskingum River cooling water infrastructure; Aligned has not confirmed whether this will be utilized.
aligned-conesville-oh.source: Aligned Data Centers official press release – Ohio mega-scale AI campus expansion
aligned-conesville-oh.notes: Brownfield redevelopment of former AEP Conesville coal plant (2 GW, operational 62 years, closed May 2020). Frontier Group of Companies acquired the plant in 2020 and built the Conesville Industrial Park across ~2,500 acres; Aligned purchased a 197-acre parcel. Aligned describes the project as 'AI/HPC' and 'Gigascale' in its press materials, and this is its third Ohio campus (others: Perkins Township/Sandusky, 96 MW total; Pataskala). Multi-building campus — renderings show up to four buildings; second, third, and fourth buildings referenced at groundbreaking. Capacity MW not publicly disclosed. Investment described as 'multi-billion dollar' — no firm figure confirmed; field omitted per policy. Construction jobs described as 'thousands'; permanent roles as 'hundreds of high-quality long-term positions' — projections only, numeric fields omitted. Aligned is exploring on-site nuclear power (SMRs) for this campus and nearby Zanesville/Cambridge sites; no agreement confirmed. Coordinates approximate (village-level). Site infrastructure funding note: the Coshocton Port Authority received a $58.7M grant (Ohio Dept of Development All Ohio Future Fund, announced July 21, 2025) for utility upgrades, water/wastewater extensions, and roadway improvements across the broader industrial park — this benefits Aligned indirectly but is not a direct subsidy to Aligned and is therefore not listed under subsidies.

google-bosc-lima-oh.name: Google Project BOSC (Lima)
google-bosc-lima-oh.water_notes: 36 cooling towers per the Ohio EPA permit application; described by Google as water-cooled. City of Lima granted 5 million gallons/day (Sept 2025).
google-bosc-lima-oh.source: Google confirmed as company behind $500m data center in Lima, Ohio
google-bosc-lima-oh.notes: Google's third Ohio data center (after New Albany and Lancaster). $500M confirmed capital investment. Codename Project BOSC; pre-announcement land/permit work via Bistrozzi LLC (Delaware shell). Coordinates are the Lima city centroid; the confirmed site is in American Township ~2 mi north of Lima (North Cole Street between Beery and Irvin Roads), ~170 acres. Capacity MW not disclosed. Google's project page states construction anticipated to begin late 2026; ~50 permanent jobs projected per DCD and 'hundreds' of construction jobs - projections, so omitted from jobs. Ohio EPA air-permit application (pending March 2026) covers 115 emergency diesel generators; 36 cooling towers specified. $50M of the investment is earmarked for local road infrastructure, $13.6M for water infrastructure.

lumen-cleveland-1-oh.name: Lumen Cleveland 1
lumen-cleveland-1-oh.notes: Confirmed via datacentermap.com, datacenters.com, and Lumen's own asset page (assets.lumen.com/cleveland-oh-data-center) that Lumen operates Cleveland-market data centers; largest/primary site is Cleveland 1 at 4000 Chester Ave, University Circle, 40,000 sqft. OSM candidate was generic 'Lumen Cleveland' without address, mapped to the flagship site.

google-stillwater-ok.name: Google Stillwater Data Center Campus
google-stillwater-ok.water_notes: Planned (permitted; not yet operational): the first two buildings would use ~2.7 million gallons/day, rising toward ~8.1 MGD if all six are built (~20% of the city's daily supply), drawn from Kaw Lake (Stillwater holds 50 MGD in rights and uses ~7 MGD on average). Cooling mechanism not specified in public sources.
google-stillwater-ok.source: Construction gets go-ahead for Google Stillwater data center
google-stillwater-ok.notes: Campus at intersection of Perkins Road and Richmond Road, north of Stillwater. Coordinates are approximate (city centroid shifted north). Up to 6 data center buildings, each 300,000 sq ft. Phase I targeted for 2027. City Council acceptance of final plat required before recording with Payne County Clerk. Job figures are projections (~30 permanent per phase; construction cited as 'thousands') - not recorded as confirmed counts. Oklahoma's Sec. 1357 data-center sales-tax exemption applies by statute but no Stillwater-specific award amount is published.

aws-boardman-morrow-county-or.name: Amazon Boardman Exascale Data Center Campus
aws-boardman-morrow-county-or.powered_by: Oregon grid (majority hydro); local retail utility PacifiCorp (Pacific Power)
aws-boardman-morrow-county-or.water_notes: Reflects Amazon's documented Oregon cooling practice — primarily free-air cooling with evaporative assist, with up to ~96% of cooling water returned to local farmers. Planning documents model roughly 35 million gallons/year for the full 1 GW campus (a projection). The specific cooling design for this proposed campus is not confirmed.
aws-boardman-morrow-county-or.source: Amazon Purchases 1,300 Acres in Morrow County, Oregon
aws-boardman-morrow-county-or.notes: Amazon confirmed the land purchase ($37M per Morrow County property records, confirmed by multiple news sources) but stated development plans are not final. Planning documents submitted to Morrow County describe a 1 GW exascale campus with 20 buildings across 4 million sq ft; Johnson Economics estimated $8B-$12B total investment. Land previously owned by Threemile Canyon Farms dairy. Distinct from Amazon's existing ~800 acres of operating/under-construction OR facilities. Lincoln Chronicle source URL returned 403 on fetch — primary claim supported by DCD source. energy.utility corrected from 'Bonneville Power Administration' (wholesale) to 'PacifiCorp (Pacific Power)' (retail utility). Coordinates are Boardman city centroid; exact site not publicly confirmed. Johnson Economics' economic-impact analysis (Morrow County Planning Commission, Jan 2025) models the full 1 GW campus at roughly $8 billion investment (potential range $7-12 billion), about 6,400 construction FTE over an eight-year build (~800/year) and about 560 operations FTE, assuming an Oregon Strategic Investment Program (SIP) property-tax abatement — modeled projections for a still-proposed campus, not firm commitments.

flexential-portland-hillsboro-4-pdx04-or.name: Flexential Portland - Hillsboro 4 (PDX04)
flexential-portland-hillsboro-4-pdx04-or.notes: CORRECTED sourceUrl - candidate's supplied URL pointed to Hillsboro 5 page in error. 4915 NE Starr Blvd, 138,000 sqft, 18MW, fully leased, delivers GPU/CPU-ready environments per press coverage.

sabey-umatilla-or.name: SDC Umatilla Campus
sabey-umatilla-or.water_notes: Sabey states it is "relying less on water-based cooling" for this development; a JetCool Technologies microjet liquid-cooling pilot is underway. No MGD disclosed.
sabey-umatilla-or.source: Sabey Data Centers Purchases 60 Acres in Umatilla, Oregon for 100MW+ Facility
sabey-umatilla-or.notes: Two-building, 714,540 sq ft multi-tenant campus. Groundbreaking originally Q1 2025, revised to 2024 per DCD; construction start as of July 2026 not independently confirmed. Investment figures conflicting across sources ($520M in one report, ~$950M in another); investmentUsd omitted. Coordinates are Umatilla city centroid.

aws-cumulus-salem-township-pa.name: AWS Cumulus Data Center Campus, Salem Township
aws-cumulus-salem-township-pa.powered_by: Nuclear (Susquehanna Steam Electric Station, Talen Energy PPA)

Full 960 MW build-out demand is not stated in the application.
aws-cumulus-salem-township-pa.source: AWS Acquires Talen's Nuclear Data Center Campus in Pennsylvania
aws-cumulus-salem-township-pa.notes: Adjacent to the 2.5GW Susquehanna Steam Electric Station. FERC blocked a proposed colocation agreement in April 2025, leading to the PPA structure instead. MW capacity not disclosed by Google. investmentUsd not broken out by site; $2B is the combined Dorchester County (Ridgeville + St. George) figure. Second Dorchester campus at Winding Woods Commerce Park, St. George not separately tracked here. Coordinates are Ridgeville area centroid.

google-armstrong-county-tx.name: Goodnight Campus
google-armstrong-county-tx.water_notes: No water volume or cooling system type disclosed in sources reviewed. TCEQ wastewater permit WQ0016881001 filed under the same GN DC1 LLC entity, indicating water infrastructure is being permitted; no public details available on cooling approach or projected water consumption.
google-armstrong-county-tx.source: Google commits $40bn to expand cloud and AI infrastructure in Texas through 2027
google-armstrong-county-tx.notes: Campus name: Goodnight, near the town of Claude, TX (known address: 10001 Lima Rd, Claude, TX 79019). Coordinates approximate (based on dispatch seed; county parcel area). Developed by Crusoe Energy via entity GN DC1, LLC (Delaware LLC, 255 Filmore St., Denver, CO 80206); Google is the hyperscale tenant/customer, confirmed publicly November 2025. Tax abatement agreement was signed with GN DC1, LLC in late 2024 without publicly naming the tenant. Google confirmed the Crusoe partnership but had not signed an offtake agreement for the on-site gas plant as of early 2026; negotiations on power amounts still ongoing per Google spokesperson. Planned IT capacity: Phase 1 described in tax abatement agreement as 'anticipated to consume up to 530 MW,' 4 buildings each with 4 x 25 MW data halls, on approximately 350 acres; Phase 2 (possible additional 3+ buildings) reported at up to ~500 MW additional; combined full build-out reported as 1 GW+ — all capacity figures are 'up to' ceilings from permit and abatement documents, not firm contracted amounts. Project was scaled back from an original 7-building plan (October 2025 local reporting); 4 buildings with construction permits from TDLR as of early 2026; Crusoe described 3-4 buildings as likely; grading on additional parcels suggests total program may reach 5+ buildings. First phase expected online 2026; initial county PILOT payment expected June/July 2026. The $40B Google Texas investment is a statewide commitment through 2027 covering multiple sites (Armstrong County, Haskell County, Ellis County) with no site-specific investment figure disclosed by Google. A $29B campus investment figure appeared in Aterio/Crusoe reporting — this is a projected ceiling, not a firm committed amount; omitted from investmentUsd per data-rigor policy. Distinct from Google's separate Haskell County TX site and Red Oak (Ellis County) TX sites — do not conflate.

hut8-beacon-point-robstown-tx.name: Hut 8 Beacon Point AI Campus
hut8-beacon-point-robstown-tx.water_notes: Closed-loop cooling filled once with water trucked from outside Nueces County (~4-7 year refill cycle); no municipal draw for cooling. Municipal use is ~10,000 gal/day domestic only (restrooms/sinks) - not cooling water -> reportedMgd omitted.
hut8-beacon-point-robstown-tx.source: Hut 8 commercializes first phase of 1 GW Beacon Point AI data center campus with 15-year, 352 MW IT lease
hut8-beacon-point-robstown-tx.notes: 1 GW site near Robstown, Nueces County; Phase 1 = a 15-year, 352 MW IT lease. The $9.8B base-term contract value is revenue, not capex (in notes). Delivery targeted Q3 2027. Coordinates are the Robstown area centroid. Hut 8 declined to confirm any tax abatement and the Nueces County Judge said the county's abatement policy was out of date, so none could have been granted -> subsidies honest-zero. investmentUsd records the $4.25B non-recourse project-bond financing for Phase 1 construction (352 MW + substation), distinct from the $9.8B lease contract value; the ~$17B combined Phase 1-2 figure is a projection.
